name: Rack 'n Roll - Mah Jongg Open Play in the QC
description: Free American Mah Jongg open play run by the organizers on Meetup (Quail Corners / Providence Road area). Meetup group page: "The group plays by National Mah Jongg League rules - no blanks or table rules." Players need some prior American Mah Jongg lessons; the group does not offer new-learner classes. Advance signup required.
address: Harris Teeter, 1015 Providence Road, Charlotte, NC
schedule: Monday evenings 6:00 PM (Meetup shows Mon Nov 16 6:00 PM at Harris Teeter); earlier sessions at Tap & Vine Quail Hollow, 8426 Park Road. Free; advance signup in Meetup required.
